left.text: Machine translation has a reputation for low quality. GT needs to be seen as high quality. The product delivers native-level translation quality at high speed, and the brand has to communicate that on every surface, at every size, and in every script.

right.alt: Machine translation as perceived and GT placed on a quality and speed field
